Hourglass Capital Llc bought 326,500 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.85% with the market. The hedge fund held 494,680 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.16M, up from 168,180 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hourglass Capital Llc who had been investing in Valley Natl Bancorp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $4.39 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.30% or $0.04 during the last trading session, reaching $13.26. About 3.12 million shares traded or 26.55% up from the average.
